data.text: My family taught me to leave enough fish for next season. With 100 tons in the lake, we can each catch 10 tons this month, leave 50 to reproduce, and start next month back at 100. That’s $10,000 apiece every month if we stick together. I propose we all agree to that 10-ton limit and review the reported catches each month. John, would you be willing to join that agreement?
